name: global-bar
title: Global Bar
description: The app's 44px bar across the top of every page: leading (column toggle, back and forward, workspace switcher), a centred search trigger with ⌘K, and trailing (Ask with ⌘J, Help, account). It is the desktop app's draggable title row, clears the window's own buttons, and hides on phones.

meta.whenToUse: The shell's top row (Shell's globalBar), in the browser and as the desktop app's title row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page's own header and actions (ShellTopBar), or a phone's top row.
